# NavDrawer

The left overlay drawer that holds every SongNodes destination, opened from the AppHeader hamburger and hidden the rest of the time.

`SongNodes.NavDrawer` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.NavDrawer open onClose={…} current="graph" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.NavDrawer" open="{{yes}}" on-close="{{…}}" current="graph"></x-import>
```

## Props (NavDrawerProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `open` * | `boolean` | Open state; when false the drawer is visibility-hidden. |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Called on Esc, scrim click, close button or after choosing a row. |
| `current` * | `"graph" \| "library" \| "sets" \| "paths" \| "harmony" \| "sources" \| "pipeline" \| "services" \| "home" \| "preferences"` | The current page: a module key, "home" or "preferences". |
| `badges` | `Partial<Record<ModuleKey, { value: number; label: string; status?: StatusKey }>>` | Optional per-module badge: a neutral count, or a status pill when attention is needed. |
| `hrefFor` * | `(key: ModuleKey \| "home" \| "preferences") => string` | Builds the href for a destination. |
| `onShowShortcuts` * | `() => void` | Opens the ShortcutSheet from the footer row. |
| `contained` | `boolean` | Render inside a positioned parent instead of the viewport. |
